title: The dorms
content: Hey Mallworld dreamers! You guys seemed to enjoy the previous AI art I shared for the hotel/apartment area. I wanted to show what the inside of a “dorms” area looked like for me. There are a couple different dorms, some are more shabby, but this is similar to the ones I’ve been to recently. My friend from college and I have been staying here. Pic 1 is the most accurate, pic 2 looks like the hallway in a lot of my houses. Pic 3 I just thought looked super cool, it looks more like the apartment/outdoor shopping center for me though. I am wondering if anyone else has been to these places? Feedback is welcome ☺️
